package rulefixtures

// scenario for go_perf_layer_memory_allocation_map_recreated_for_static_lookup: Layer: Memory allocation. Flag static lookup maps rebuilt inside functions instead of package-level immutable tables.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario567Positive(statusCode int) string {
	// A new map is allocated on every call to this function.
	// Since the mapping never changes, it should be a single
	// package-level map created once at init time.
	statusText := map[int]string{
		200: "OK",
		201: "Created",
		400: "Bad Request",
		404: "Not Found",
		500: "Internal Server Error",
	}
	return statusText[statusCode]
}
